mapper.select: SELECT * FROM gov_policy WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND (workspace_id = #{workspaceId} OR workspace_id IS NULL) ORDER BY version
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM gov_policy WHERE workspace_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{workspaceId} AND source = #{source}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM gov_policy WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND source = #{source} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE gov_policy SET status = 'DISABLED', update_at = now() WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND source = #{source} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
